means: There is not one, and that is the ceiling on all of this. ATLAS, LUMEN, TRAILHEAD, PAPERLIGHT and the eight supplements were all invented here. Their claims are plausible copy rather than true differentiators, so the best a picture can do is dramatise a fiction. Craft has been taken a long way on top of that - brightness tripled, motion doubled, sync fixed - and none of it can supply a reason to want the thing.
rule: Before the next commercial: what is the product, what is true about it that is not true of the alternatives, and who is currently unhappy without it. Those three answers ARE the opening shot.
evidence: grepped the repo - no real product, brand or client data anywhere.
status: OUTSTANDING - blocks the work being genuinely good rather than merely well made
